text: Free co-op demo about keeping one bus running across a wasteland.
There are no roads left, so you make your own. Someone drives, someone patches the walls from the inside.
Your main tool fires magnetic arrows. Stick one to a wreck, one to the ground, and drag it out of the way.
Best part: at the end of the trailer they try to winch the whole bus up a cliff with it.
The catch? The bus slides around like it weighs nothing, and the animations are stiff.
The demo is almost four gigs, in fourteen languages, and the full game lands November third.
Think Pacific Drive, but the car is a bus and your friends are in it.
Worth a dip. Hold my wheel.
